hobbies.name: Music Production
hobbies.description: Davit produces electronic music under the alias 'Shepard D', combining melodic atmosphere, emotional storytelling, and modern electronic sound design. He collaborates with local artists and participates in creative music projects.

hobbies.name: Fitness & Gym
hobbies.description: Davit regularly works out and views fitness as an important part of discipline, self-development, and maintaining mental clarity alongside engineering work.

hobbies.name: Developer Community Building
hobbies.description: Beyond engineering, Davit enjoys organizing technical events, workshops, and conferences that bring developers together and help grow the engineering community in Armenia.

hobbies.name: Teaching & Mentorship
hobbies.description: Davit enjoys mentoring engineers and students, simplifying complex technical concepts, and helping others grow in software engineering and architecture.

hobbies.name: AI & Emerging Technologies
hobbies.description: Passionate about AI agents, developer tooling, intelligent automation, and experimenting with modern AI-assisted engineering workflows.

hobbies.name: Travel & Outdoor Exploration
hobbies.description: Enjoys traveling, hiking, exploring new places, and participating in community and technology events internationally.
